caption: What if you used 100% of your brain? Here's the thing: you already do. The idea that we only use 10% of our brain is a myth. Brain scans show activity in virtually every part of the brain over a day, and even while you sleep, big areas stay busy. Your brain is only about 2% of your body weight, but it burns roughly 20% of your energy, running on about 20 watts, like a dim bulb that never switches off. It has about 86 billion neurons, and only some of them fire at any one moment. When lots of neurons fire together in one sudden, uncontrolled burst, that's a seizure, not a superpower. And the twist: brain tissue has no pain receptors. That's why some brain surgery is done while the patient is awake, with only the scalp numbed. Which brain fact surprised YOU the most? 👇
